name: Ink Master
description: A group of the country's most creative and skilled tattoo artists compete for a hundred thousand dollars and the title of Ink Master. The stakes couldn't be higher with "living canvasses" donating their skin to be permanently marked in this adrenalized competition elimination.

videos.title: Most Controversial: You Choose Live
videos.overview: Relive the craziest Ink Master moments with Dave Navarro: wild fights, busted tattoos and epic eliminations. America votes for the most insane moment.

videos.title: Merry Ink
videos.overview: Tatu Baby, Sausage, Jime Litwalk and James Vaughn vie for redemption and a shot at $10k as they tattoo Christmas-obsessed canvases with holiday tattoos.

videos.title: New Year's Ink
videos.overview: It's a clash of big egos when Josh Hibbard, Gentle Jay, Al Fliction, and Cee Jay return to battle for redemption and $10k.

videos.title: Most Infamous
videos.overview: The most loved, hated, and talked about artists and canvases from past seasons of Ink Master return.

videos.title: Master vs. Master
videos.overview: In an elite battle of heavyweights, 4 Ink Master winners collide to prove they are the best of the best.

videos.title: HallowInk
videos.overview: Bili Vegas, Clint Cummings, Cleen Rock One, and St. Marq compete for $10k, inking Halloween-themed tats.

videos.title: Cupid's Ink
videos.overview: Nick D’Angelo, Mystical Mike, Ashley Bennett, and Julia Carlson battle it out for $10,000.

videos.title: Sirens of Ink
videos.overview: Lea Vendetta, Sarah Miller, Jackie Jennings, and Emily Elegado bring the heat as they fight for $10,000.

videos.title: The Decision
videos.overview: The judges, finalists, and Eliminated Artists Jury discuss the decision at the Ink Master Revenge finale.

videos.title: ink master specials
videos.overview: specials

videos.title: Master Canvas Reveal | Ink Master: Turf War
videos.overview: With the cancellation of the Ink Master finale due to COVID-19, join us as finalists Jimmy Snaz, Bob Jones and Angel Rose reveal and discuss their master canvas tattoos in this exclusive Master Canvas Reveal. Let’s celebrate an incredible season and all of the artists’ hard work!

videos.title: Fresh Meat
videos.overview: Ten of the best tattoo artists on the planet tattoo Human Canvases in a series of extreme challenges. The first Artist is eliminated on the path to determining who will earn a $100,000 prize and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Botched Head Tattoo
videos.overview: A head tattoo becomes a medical emergency and tempers explode when Heather challenges the judges. Ton Jones serves as Guest Judge and a second artist is eliminated from the competition, losing the chance to win $100K.

videos.title: Pasties and a Cameltoe
videos.overview: Naked women heat up the competition and another head tattoo sparks a fight between Al and Bili. A third artist is eliminated from the competition and the chance to win $100K

videos.title: Ink Disaster Piece
videos.overview: Photo Realism tattoos turn disastrous when Bili has difficulty with muscle structure and Heather’s art goes up in flames. A fourth artist is eliminated from the competition.

videos.title: Game On
videos.overview: Competition turns cut-throat when Josh calls out Shane for only doing black & grey. Shane fights to prove his color skills and impress the judges. A fifth artist is eliminated from the competition.

videos.title: Permanent Mistakes
videos.overview: Tattoos are forever and so are the mistakes! The artists are plagued with massive mistakes while tattooing pinups on their canvasses. A sixth artist is eliminated from the competition and the chance to win $100K.

videos.title: Picture Imperfect
videos.overview: Some of the remaining artists botch their portrait tattoos by screwing up important features, leaving their human canvasses with bad art. 4 artists remain but only 1 will take home $100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Ink Master Revealed
videos.overview: In the season finale, human canvasses blindly agree to let the remaining artists tattoo anything they want on their skin. A grueling 18 hours of tattooing with a shocking twist! Who will take home $100K & the title of Ink Master?

videos.title: Tattooing the Dead
videos.overview: A visit to the morgue launches 16 of the best tattoo artists into a brutal competition to determine who's #1 and "tattoo virgins" get their first taste of ink with one ending in a permanent disaster!

videos.title: Semi Nude 911
videos.overview: Semi nude women heat up the competition, a medical emergency threatens the future of one artist, and NFL Linebacker Terrell Suggs is a guest judge.

videos.title: The 80 Year Old Virgin
videos.overview: A botched American flag and a backwards eagle tattoo cause veterans' patriotic tempers to flare and a third artist loses their shot at $100,000 dollars and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Tattoo Her What?
videos.overview: A face-off leaves Sarah in tears and the artists are pushed to their limits when one canvas demands a tattoo on her private parts and another has a meltdown, which causes a fight in the loft. The NBA's Matt Barnes guest judges.

videos.title: Trick or Freak
videos.overview: Halloween gets freaky when the artists tattoo inside mouths. One artist reveals shocking news that lands him in in the hospital fighting for his life. Human canvases want tattoos of dismembered bodies and zombies. Another artist loses their shot at $100K dollars.

videos.title: Half Naked and Fully Loaded
videos.overview: Guns and a hot, half naked Pinup model set the stage for one artist's plan for revenge. Some of the artists botch their Pinup Tattoos, leaving their Human Canvases scarred and the judges steaming mad. Another artist loses their shot at $100K dollars.

videos.title: Star Wars Forever
videos.overview: The artists must use their Jedi powers to ink highly critical super-fans with Star Wars tattoos. Star Wars creator, George Lucas, has a special treat for the winner of the Flash Challenge. Another artista loses their shot at $100K dollars.

videos.title: Holy Ink
videos.overview: Alliances are made and betrayed when the artists team up to work in pairs and one team must ink priest. Tatu Baby gets a surprise advantage that angers the rest of the artists. Tattoo legend Freddy Negrete is guest judge.

videos.title: Buck Off
videos.overview: The artists burn designs onto skin tight chaps worn by smokin' hot cowgirls. The pressure is on when the artists try to impress Nunez by tattooing in his style, Japanese. Another artist is forced to close shop.

videos.title: Blowing Chunks
videos.overview: Dave Navarro ups the stakes when he gives the artists his personal guitars to paint for the Flash Challenge. One Human Canvas can't stop puking. Animal tattoos leave two artists going head to head and the judges split 50/50.

videos.title: Better Than Words?
videos.overview: The artists tattoo head-to-head against Oliver in the Flash Challenge. The portrait challenge leaves some canvases with unrecognizable family members permanently inked on their skin. Another artist is forced to close shop.

videos.title: The Bigger They Are
videos.overview: The artists lose control when pro-athlete canvases choose them. Tattoo pain has these NFL and MMA pros on the floor. The judges choose the final three and the unbelievable final challenge is revealed. Live finale follows.

videos.title: Ink Master Live
videos.overview: This season's artists and human canvases confront each other live. America's votes and insane twists are announced, master canvases are revealed, and the judges choose the next Ink Master.

videos.title: Baby Got Back
videos.overview: 16 new artists find themselves tattooing in prison. Tatu Baby returns and the Human Canvases vote to eliminate one artist as the battle for $100,000 & the title of Ink Master begins.

videos.title: Thrills For Grills
videos.overview: Artists permanently ink human canvases with gruesome realistic tattoos of blood, guts, and organs. A betrayal leads to an explosive fight in the loft. Tennessee Titans Running Back Chris Johnson is a Guest Judge.

videos.title: Tattoos And Lace
videos.overview: Skimpy lingerie heats up the flash challenge and a major twist leaves the Artists fighting for their lives. A difficult human canvas leads to the most shocking elimination in Ink Master history.

videos.title: Elysium Challenge
videos.overview: When the artists must assemble a tattoo machine from scratch, canvases end up with totally crooked bar code tattoos. The house turns on Joshua and another artist loses a shot at 100K.

videos.title: Baby Beat-Down
videos.overview: Artists tattoo over serious scars and they try to beat Tatu Baby at her own game - Day of the Dead tattoos. A Canvas wants Tatu Baby's face permanently inked on his skin.

videos.title: Animal Instinct
videos.overview: Hot models and jungle animals make for a wild Flash Challenge. When the Artists ink Asian tattoos, a severed head and a buttcrack tattoo send the Judges reeling. Jime gives Joshua a taste of his own medicine and another Artist is eliminated.

videos.title: Monumental Mistakes
videos.overview: Tempers boil over when artists get the chance to work on Dave Navarro. An unlikely artist wins the flash challenge, turning allies into enemies & multiple canvasses are left with bad tattoos for the rest of their lives.

videos.title: Baby Don't Go
videos.overview: The competition gets personal when the Artists must tattoo each other. Then, last season's Artists become the most brutal group of Canvases yet when they return to get inked. Tatu Baby cracks and faces elimination.

videos.title: Skulls And Villains
videos.overview: The Artists trade in living Canvases for dead ones when they engrave human skulls. When they ink badass DC Comic tattoos, one contestant becomes the ultimate super villain sending another talented artist packing.

videos.title: Eyes Of The Beholder
videos.overview: Eyelid tattoos have the Artists in tears. Joshua attacks and Tatu Baby bites back. The Artists ink portraits and one Canvas gets a portrait of Dave Navarro. The Human Canvas Jury ends in tears and another Artist loses a shot at $100K grand.

videos.title: Heroes & Heads
videos.overview: The Artists honor military heroes on the deck of the Intrepid aircraft carrier. Then, they must ink complex tattoos onto Canvas' heads. Oliver has a meltdown in an explosive critique and the Judges are deadlocked about who to send home. Another Artist is eliminated.

videos.title: Enduring The Pain
videos.overview: The last 4 Artists endure an epic tattoo marathon to earn a spot in the Live Finale. An insane twist has all four finalists tattooing the same Canvas at the same time. Tensions are high & one more Artist loses a shot at 100K.

videos.title: The Epic Finale
videos.overview: The final 3 Artists battle it out Live on their toughest canvas yet. America’s vote on who will get a second chance to come back next season is revealed & one Artist is crowned the Ink Master, taking home the $100K grand prize.

videos.title: Earn It!
videos.overview: A new crop of talented and cutthroat Artists learn they must first earn an Ink Master shop by tattooing hundreds of canvases Convention Style.

videos.title: Bug Out
videos.overview: One artist snaps and is determined to leave the competition. Live poisonous scorpions, tarantulas and eyeballs are tattooed.

videos.title: Tatt Ganged
videos.overview: Bikini clad twins try to endure the remaining 10 tattoo artists all drilling them at once. An injury sends one Artist to the emergency ward.

videos.title: Nude & Tattooed
videos.overview: The Artists get up close and awkward with naked Canvases. The game is on when one Artist screws everyone over. New York Yankees Legend CC Sabathia is Guest Judge. Another Artist loses a shot at $100K.

videos.title: X-Men's Hugh Jackman
videos.overview: The Artists ink X-Men superfans with iconic X-Men characters in the first ever color portrait challenge. The Ultimate authority chooses the winner...Hugh Jackman. A thrilling sneak peek of X-Men: Days of Future Past is revealed.

videos.title: 2 on 1 Tat-Astrophe
videos.overview: The Artists are forced to work in pairs and end up at each other's throats. When a Canvas passes out, one Artist takes matters into his own hands, and another loses his marbles. The Judges make a drastic decision.

videos.title: Artist Slaughter
videos.overview: Halo hears smack talk & gets revenge. Drama erupts when broken-hearted Canvases want tattoos they got for their exes covered. Kyle starts to crack & pressure is on when the Judges announce a massacre, sending 2 Artists home.

videos.title: Ink Master Explosion
videos.overview: Kyle can't take the heat anymore & takes it out on Nunez. The Flash Challenge gets more explosive when the Artists use Gunpowder to make Art. King of Horror Rob Zombie steps up as Guest Judge for gory tattoos of creepy Demons.

videos.title: Fighting Dirty
videos.overview: The Artists make mouth grills for champion boxer Brandon Rios. A fight with a Canvas ends in disaster. Jay's plan to take out Scott results in an explosive critique as the final 6 battle it out for the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Tag Team Tatt
videos.overview: One of the biggest twists in Ink Master history has Artists depending on each other to survive. One Artist wages a full on attack. The fight for the final five is on as two Artists are forced to face off to prove themselves.

videos.title: Karma's a Bitch
videos.overview: Artists board a yacht for a bird's eye view of the Statue of Liberty, but a surprise leaves them panicking. As the fight intensifies, one Artist uses cutthroat strategy to get ahead & top dogs end up on the chopping block.

videos.title: Fight to the Finish
videos.overview: The artists help breast cancer survivors with tattoos that help the women reclaim their bodies; the season comes full circle in a convention tattoo cover-up challenge.

videos.title: Ink Master Live
videos.overview: Artists and judges reflect on their experiences during the season, and America's votes are tallied. As a new "Ink Master" is crowned, the season three winner inks a canvas.

videos.title: Inking With The Enemy
videos.overview: 18 Rival Artists enter for $100k and the Ink Master title. It's their worst nightmare as they're forced to ink with their enemy.

videos.title: Pin Up Pittfalls
videos.overview: Semi-nude models bring the heat and a game changing twist is revealed. Jacked pin ups make the critique a bloodbath & rivalries flare.

videos.title: Head to Headache
videos.overview: Josh ignites rivalries while two artists receive an advantage no one in the competition has ever had and their cutthroat strategy has tension soaring.

videos.title: Geishas Gone Wrong
videos.overview: Vendettas have the artists at each others' throats. The skull pick gets personal and the pressure is on when the artists tattoo Nunez's specialty.

videos.title: Glass On Blast
videos.overview: The artists must make incredible art by sand blasting glass while trying to survive working in teams. Rivalries explode when they tattoo head to head.

videos.title: Cheek To Cheek
videos.overview: In one of the craziest challenges ever, the artists must ink 12 hour gluteus maximus tattoos. A medical emergency may cost one artist the competition.

videos.title: Three's A Crowd
videos.overview: The pressure is on when the artists take on Oliver's specialty - and it’s tripled when they have to work in teams.

videos.title: Ink My Oosik
videos.overview: The artists are taken out of their comfort zone when they must scrimshaw walrus penises. One artist totally loses their cool while another artist loses their shot at $100K.

videos.title: Virgin Blood
videos.overview: Picky virgin canvases get inked and Jason's anxiety threatens to take him out. The artists battle head to head and Josh plays dirty, putting his opponent on the chopping block.

videos.title: Cold Blooded
videos.overview: In the flash challenge, the artists use a different kind of ink to make art... blood. Then, they go head-to-head against guest judge Tommy Montoya while Emily goes over the edge.

videos.title: Up In Smoke
videos.overview: Josh causes a controversy that could get him kicked out of the competition for good. The Artists tattoo amputees where their limbs once were.

videos.title: Heads Will Roll
videos.overview: The artists fight for an opportunity to ink NFL star DeAngelo Williams as he honors his mother who died of breast cancer. Head tattoos send one human canvas over the edge.

videos.title: Painstaking Portraits
videos.overview: Artists go head to head tattooing the same portrait on two family members. Some family members are left with jacked tattoos as the portrait subject overlooks.

videos.title: Firing Squad
videos.overview: It's down to the wire as the artists battle for a top 4 spot - to survive they must impress 3 tattoo heavyweights criticizing their every move.

videos.title: Fight To The Finale
videos.overview: Emotional outbursts, explosive fights, incredible tattoos and epic fails. It’s the end of the line and the sparks fly as the last 4 Artists standing battle it out for a spot in the Live Finale and a shot at $100K.

videos.title: Ink Live
videos.overview: The final 3 artists reveal their 35 hour back pieces and the sparks fly when all 18 rival artists return to give the lowdown on whose rivalries still burn.

videos.title: Meet Your Maker
videos.overview: In the season premiere, apprentices battle their masters to prove they are the best.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: Oliver Peck's mentor guest judges, delivering a smack down when the artists take on his specialty.

videos.title: Sink or Swim
videos.overview: It's sink or swim when the artists team up to ink underwater ocean scenes on the back of canvas' hands.

videos.title: Tut for Tat
videos.overview: Teams adorn sarcophaguses while an artist's vicious skull picks for Egyptian tattoos angers the rest.

videos.title: Problem Parts
videos.overview: Naked models are used to create mind-blowing illusions and a cutthroat artist gets a chance at vengeance.

videos.title: Firing Lines
videos.overview: Heads roll when artists must take on a legend in the elimination challenge.

videos.title: Predator/Prey
videos.overview: In the most insane challenge yet, the artists must tattoo 4 on 1 to transform canvases into wild animals.

videos.title: Composed and Exposed
videos.overview: A new tattoo style pushes the artists' limits, resulting in mind-blowing masterpieces and mistakes.

videos.title: Like a Moth to the Flame
videos.overview: The artists find themselves painting with fire in the Flash Challenge. A romance between a couple of the artists tests loyalties.

videos.title: Hell on Wheels
videos.overview: The stakes soar when the artists paint their most valuable canvas and one artist's lies raise suspicions.

videos.title: Hail Mani
videos.overview: The artists give religious tattoo virgins their first ink - on their fingernails.

videos.title: Slitting Throats
videos.overview: The artists work with guests in a high stakes challenge and Chris forces an artist to prove loyalty.

videos.title: Player's Choice
videos.overview: Professional football players call the shots in the elimination tattoo, knocking artists off their game.

videos.title: Active Duty
videos.overview: Artists fight for a spot in the top four and must tattoo portraits of active military and their loved ones before they are separated for deployment.

videos.title: Go Big Or Go Home
videos.overview: The last four artists standing fight for a spot in the live finale, but first must survive a tattoo marathon.

videos.title: Master Vs. Apprentice Live
videos.overview: The final three artists tattoo live for $100K while eliminated artists return to confront each other.

videos.title: Initiation
videos.overview: The battle for $100,000 begins as new artists compete in the most intense Flash Challenge to date; the competition heats up when the first veteran artist returns seeking revenge.

videos.title: One Man's Trash
videos.overview: Egos collide when the artists get their hands dirty in a team Flash Challenge; another veteran returns.

videos.title: Salt in the Wound
videos.overview: In the Flash Challenge, working in teams of two leaves some of the Artists feeling salty and a Veteran Artist schemes to take back control. The battle continues for 100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: The Devil's in the Details
videos.overview: The artists face the most extreme test of detail ever attempted; a veteran artist returns and sparks old rivalries.

videos.title: New School, Old Artist
videos.overview: The artists use plenty of color during a contortionist body painting Flash Challenge; a veteran artist returns and adds a new-school twist to an old subject.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: Bonds are tested and new alliances are formed during an intense Flash Challenge; a veteran joins the New Artist Alliance to take down a common enemy.

videos.title: Knuckle Sandwich
videos.overview: Alliances are broken during a white-knuckled flash challenge.

videos.title: Breathing Fire
videos.overview: The final veteran artist arrives with a challenge in legibility that has the judges out for blood.

videos.title: Sink or Soar
videos.overview: The artists work in pairs to execute large-scale back pieces testing texture...and each other’s nerves.

videos.title: Shipwrecked
videos.overview: Alliances are tested as the remaining artists must tattoo in teams of three.

videos.title: Head in the Game
videos.overview: Stakes are at a competition high when the artists must ink the ultimate in-your-face tattoo.

videos.title: Turning the Tables
videos.overview: The tables are turned when the new artists call the shots in the elimination tattoo and get revenge.

videos.title: Revenge Live
videos.overview: The final three artists reveal two master canvases; eliminated artists return and confront each other for the first time since the competition; a winner is crowned.

videos.title: Weeding Out The Weak
videos.overview: The judges show no mercy as 30 artists fight to earn one of the 18 spots on teams Peck and Nunez.

videos.title: The Game Begins
videos.overview: In the first Flash Challenge, Team Peck and Team Nunez must work together in an intense tattoo challenge.

videos.title: Ruffled Feathers
videos.overview: Team Nunez seeks revenge in the next Flash Challenge and an artist betrays Team Beck in their first Elimination Tattoo.

videos.title: Put On Your Armor
videos.overview: No Artist is safe when both Team Peck and Team Nunez must transform Canvases into Warriors in the Elimination Tattoo. The battle continues for 100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Sparks Fly
videos.overview: Team Nunez fries in an electrifying Flash Challenge testing legibility. A gendered alliance has the girls out for blood. The battle intensifies for 100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Sticky Situation
videos.overview: A conflicted Team Peck fights for control of the game in a Flash Challenge testing contrast. One Artist turns the tables on the girls’ alliance. The battle continues for 100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: New School, Old Scars
videos.overview: In a powerful Flash Challenge, the artists must tattoo former smokers who have been scarred for life.

videos.title: Bent Out Of Shape
videos.overview: The battle for the skull pick heats up in the Flash Challenge when artists must manipulate metal.

videos.title: Head Games
videos.overview: No one is safe when the artists must use adaptability to tattoo an excruciatingly painful spot: the head.

videos.title: Like Sand Through The Hour Glass
videos.overview: It's all in the details when the artists must create powerful designs for Dodge Chargers.

videos.title: Duck and Cover Up
videos.overview: One artist cracks after a difficult Flash Challenge in which the artists try to rework tramp stamps.

videos.title: Road To The Finale
videos.overview: Dave digs deeper into the lives and strategies of the final 6 artists from Team Peck and Team Nuñez.

videos.title: Heavy Lifting
videos.overview: The artists must carry their own weight in a team Flash Challenge, leading to an unexpected win.

videos.title: Bio-Mechanical Failure
videos.overview: Stakes are at a competition-high when the artists must work in teams to transform canvases into cyborgs.

videos.title: No One Is Safe
videos.overview: The battle comes to a head as the top four artists must endure a grueling tattoo marathon.

videos.title: Peck Vs. Nuñez Live
videos.overview: The final 3 artists tattoo live for America's vote and the eliminated artists return for a confrontation.

videos.title: Fire & Ice
videos.overview: In the season premiere, tattooing is a team sport as artists from nine of America’s best shops arrive ready to battle it out for a massive $200K and the first ever title of Master Shop.

videos.title: Crossing the Line
videos.overview: A massive twist shakes up the competition and a painstaking Flash Challenge puts relationships to the test.

videos.title: Unnatural Disasters
videos.overview: A fiery veteran artist returns, taking the competition by storm; a difficult Flash Challenge exposes weaknesses in the shops.

videos.title: Lend Me Your Ear
videos.overview: The competition gets even tougher when the artists are tested on technical application with individual tattoos. Not one but two veteran artists return.

videos.title: War and Ink
videos.overview: Some shops lose their composure as they butt heads during a grueling elimination tattoo.

videos.title: Get the Flock Outta Here
videos.overview: Shops crumble as the tension between teammates intensifies.

videos.title: On the Bubble
videos.overview: One of the competition's most infamous veterans returns to shake up the game.

videos.title: Masterpiece Mayhem
videos.overview: An emotional flash challenge brings the artists to tears, and the alliance becomes a target when a bullet-proof pair of veterans return to battle it out for the title.

videos.title: Pin-Up Panic Attack
videos.overview: The Artists can't find any relief in a sculptural Flash Challenge. Things only get hairier during the Elimination Tattoo when the Artists are faced with the infamous Pin-Up challenge.

videos.title: Drill Baby, Drill
videos.overview: The final veteran shop returns to fight for the title of Master Shop. Skull picks are key to the precision strike leveled at the opposing aliance.

videos.title: Grim Inker
videos.overview: With no flash challenge, the artists think they've got it all figured out until a massive twist sends them reeling; Four Horsemen tattoos bring on the end of days for one pair of artists.

videos.title: Pit Fall
videos.overview: A painful elimination tattoo has the artists in the pits, and a massive twist sends them reeling.

videos.title: Sell Out
videos.overview: The competition puts the old saying, "the customer is always right," to the test when the artists must sell themselves to their canvases for the chance to tattoo.

videos.title: Casting the First Stone
videos.overview: With only 5 shops left, the fight for $200K and the title of Master Shop intensifies.  In a deity Elimination Tattoo, some shops reach for the heavens while one is sent packing to hell.

videos.title: Marathon to the Finale
videos.overview: The competition is more intense than ever as the top four shops battle it out in a tattoo marathon for the three spots in the live finale, $200K and the first ever title of Master Shop.

videos.title: Shop Wars Finale
videos.overview: In the live season finale, the final three shops battle it out for $200,000 and the first ever title of Master Shop.

videos.title: Pick Your Side
videos.overview: Three of the most skilled Ink Masters return for a new challenge, but instead of battling alone they’ll coach teams of the top tattoo artists nationwide. The epic battle for $100K and the title of Ink Master begins.

videos.title: Fill’er Up
videos.overview: The Competition is fierce and the Masters must coach their team in season 10’s first Flash Challenge, testing fundamentals. Some artists find their way in the Elimination Tattoo, but one hits a dead end and is sent packing.

videos.title: Divine Proportion
videos.overview: The Masters face off to ensure the survival of their team; proportion skills are put to the test when the artists tattoo Greek deities.

videos.title: Step It Up
videos.overview: The coaches step in during a team-based Flash Challenge. Ingenuity is tested with mash up tattoos.

videos.title: Ink On The Dotted Line
videos.overview: Precision skills are put to the test when the Artists must create masterpieces with hole punches. Will one of the Coaches put his own skin on the line for the chance of $100K and the title of Ink Master?

videos.title: Chin Up
videos.overview: The coaches must lead by example when they’re forced to tattoo the under chin in a Master’s Face off. The Artists’ adaptability is tested with undead tattoos as rivalries heat up in the battle for 100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Eye of the Tiger
videos.overview: Team dynamics are put to the test when a tag team challenge shakes the competition to its core.

videos.title: Pane in the Glass
videos.overview: Teamwork is essential in a glass painting Flash Challenge testing dimension; Artists create stone tattoos in the Elimination Tattoo and one cracks under the pressure; the rest keep fighting for 100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Ink Raider
videos.overview: The devil is in the details when the artists must tattoo intricate Technicolor hot-air balloons. The battle is heating up for 100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Some Assembly Required
videos.overview: Teamwork is the name of the game in a series of Tag Team Tattoo Challenges. A massive twist forces one Team's Artists to turn on their own.

videos.title: Quit Buggin' Me
videos.overview: The smaller the tattoo, that harder the coaches may fall in a micro Masters Face Off. In the Elimination Tattoo, one artist takes a blow to the chest and is sent packing.

videos.title: Total Meltdown
videos.overview: The heat of the competition is higher than ever when the artists are tested in composition using melted wax.

videos.title: Monkey See, Monkey Do
videos.overview: The stakes are higher than ever when the artists match the designs of their coaches; in a freehand face off, one artist falls out of the competition for good.

videos.title: No Stain, No Gain
videos.overview: One Team leaves their mark on a wood staining Flash Challenge testing contrast, and one Artist packs their machine and leaves the Competition for good. The battle continues on for $100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Final Exam
videos.overview: With a spot in the final three on the line, the Artists push themselves to the limit in a grueling tattoo Challenge.

videos.title: Return of the Masters Finale
videos.overview: As the three remaining artists and their coaches compete onstage to win it all, the eliminated artists return to cast judgment on the finalists.

videos.title: Opening Shots
videos.overview: Cleen Rock One and Christian Buckingham, two of Ink Master's most legendary rivals, return to the ring, and 22 new artists compete for spots on their teams.

videos.title: Not on My Watch
videos.overview: Team Cleen and Team Christian go head to head in a flash challenge that tests their fundamentals, and time flies when the artists tackle a difficult elimination tattoo.

videos.title: Right on Target
videos.overview: The teams face off in a high-pressure challenge using dominoes, and the elimination tattoo forces the artists to think outside the box.

videos.title: No Wrist, No Reward
videos.overview: Cleen and Christian battle it out in their first grudge match to see whose team will have to compete in a wristband elimination tattoo challenge.

videos.title: That's Gonna Leave a Mark
videos.overview: A flash challenge using electrical tape forces the teams to test their creativity, and the artists face challenging placements on their canvases during the elimination tattoo.

videos.title: Fight Your Own Battles
videos.overview: It's survival of the fittest when Teams Christian and Cleen must tattoo epic battle scenes head-to-head. The grudge match continues for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: No Wasted Space
videos.overview: The Artists step aside and put faith in their Coaches as Cleen and Christian each tattoo four Canvases in a head-to-head marathon. The Artists must then tattoo galaxies and one is sent to outer space.

videos.title: Chalk This Way
videos.overview: The artists must scour the depths of their imagination to create mind-bending masterpieces with sidewalk chalk; the grudge match continues for $100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Tipping the Scales
videos.overview: The coaches face off to save their artists from elimination; mermaid tattoos take the grudge match to the sea; the battle continues for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Put Up or Shut Up
videos.overview: Pitting the artists against the opposing coach, the competition puts the artists' finesse to the test; the grudge match continues for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: In Deep Waters
videos.overview: The artists must compose an incredible work of art that's completely invisible in the flash challenge; one artist gets caught in the splash zone and is sent packing.

videos.title: Too Hot to Handle
videos.overview: The tools are hot but the competition is on fire as the artists battle for control in the flash challenge; the battle heats up for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Who's Got the Power?
videos.overview: With only six artists remaining, the power to control the game is everything; the battle for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master is more intense than ever before when the artists must collaborate to create powerful tattoos.

videos.title: What Are You Crayon About?
videos.overview: There's nowhere to hide when the artists are tested in precision portraiture; one artist misses the mark and is sent packing; the battle continues for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Prelude to a Bloodbath
videos.overview: Four artists remain but only three earn a spot in the finale where they battle it out for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master; Cleen and Christian are one step closer to settling the score in the ultimate grudge match.

videos.title: Grudge Match Finale
videos.overview: Christian Buckingham and Cleen Rock One return to settle the grudge match once and for all; the battle concludes as the top three artists reveal their 35-hour master canvas tattoos and one artist wins the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: The Ink Will Speak For Itself
videos.overview: Nine men and nine women kick off an epic battle of the sexes by going head to head in a team collaboration tattoo to prove they have what it takes to be the next Ink Master.

videos.title: A Storm Is Brewin'
videos.overview: The judges unveil a new twist and bring in heavy-hitting veterans Joey Hamilton and Ryan Ashley to coach the teams, whose black-and-gray shading skills are put to the test.

videos.title: Down to the Wire
videos.overview: Two-time veterans Bubba Irwin and Sarah Miller return to coach the men's and women's teams, and the artists showcase their knack for legibility by inking surrealistic tattoos.

videos.title: The Hunter & The Hunted
videos.overview: Cam's arrogant behavior continues to irritate his team members during a color contrast challenge, and the gang bands together to sabotage Cam's standing in the competition.

videos.title: The Art Stands Alone
videos.overview: It's every man and woman for themselves when the artists tattoo any design in any style before a blind critique from the judges.

videos.title: Art of War
videos.overview: In a test of consistency, the teams must engrave full suits of armor, then a cross-stitch style elimination tattoo throws all the artists for a loop.

videos.title: Sabotage
videos.overview: The artists go head-to-head in a test of technical application, and the losers fight for their survival in an elimination tattoo challenge dictated by the victors.

videos.title: Pins & No Needles
videos.overview: The judges test the artists' understanding of color theory; two coaches take the artists to school; the battle intensifies for $100K and the title of "Ink Master."

videos.title: By Accident or By Design
videos.overview: The battle for the grand prize and title of Ink Master continues as the judges test the artists' adaptability.

videos.title: Roll of the Dice
videos.overview: The artists find themselves in a dicey situation with confrontational coaches Josh Payne and Nikki Simpson.

videos.title: Put Your Ink Where Your Mouth Is
videos.overview: The competition tests the artists' ability to market themselves when the power is in the hands of the canvases.

videos.title: Moving Pictures
videos.overview: The artists are on their own in a test of finesse as the six remaining competitors fight for the cash prize and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Unfriendly Fire
videos.overview: It's a battle of the sexes as the men's team takes aim at the women during an illustrative portrait challenge.

videos.title: Step Up or Shut Up
videos.overview: The last four artists remaining battle it out in a tattoo marathon to secure their spot in the season finale.

videos.title: Battle of the Sexes Finale
videos.overview: Seven veteran artists battle it out in the "Clash of the Coaches Face Off"; the battle of the sexes comes to an end as the three finalists reveal their 35-hour Master Canvas tattoos and one artist wins the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Rep Your Region
videos.overview: The artists tattoo their home states and face blind critiques by the judges, a competitor makes a drastic choice, and patriotic tattoos decide someone's fate in the Face Off.

videos.title: Clash of the Collages
videos.overview: The South aims to unify and rebound when the teams are tasked with a postcard mural on the side of a bus, and a compass rose elimination tattoo includes a game-changing twist.

videos.title: Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
videos.overview: Ride or die, team tensions run high when the artists endure a tattoo marathon with the others from their home turf. The artists who fail to collaborate risk $100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Battle Lines
videos.overview: To test legibility, the teams spin intricate designs with yarn on outdoor canvases, then get technical with schematic tattoos.

videos.title: Out of Your Element
videos.overview: Just as the Teams think they've figured out the Turf War, a shocking twist lights the competition ablaze and burns it down to its very core.

videos.title: Off the Chain
videos.overview: The Turf War is more intense than ever before and to survive the Artists must fight for every possible advantage and ally; cross-team alliance takes shape, and a glowing elimination challenge leaves one team burned.

videos.title: Head Spin
videos.overview: A Team Challenge takes the Artists for a spin leaving them dizzied and out of control; the Turf War grows more intense than ever as the battle continues for $100K and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Sugar Rush
videos.overview: The Artists hunger for the win, now more than ever before, when they tattoo sweet full color new school food tattoos; one Artist bites off more than they can chew.

videos.title: Artistry on the Line
videos.overview: The teams are put to the test in artistry with an Ink Master favorite: pin-ups.

videos.title: From Toast to Toast
videos.overview: The Artists' shading skills are tested in a monumentally hard Elimination Tattoo.

videos.title: Last Draw
videos.overview: Pressure grows as the Turf War ranks run thin and the Artists' versatility is tested when an alliance strategy backfires, putting an unexpected frontrunner on the chopping block.

videos.title: There Can Only Be One
videos.overview: The artists fight for survival in an "Ink Master" staple: portraits; a shocking skull pick threatens the team dynamic; one artist shows precisely who they're looking out for.

videos.title: Compose Yourself
videos.overview: Hosted by rock legend Dave Navarro and judged by icons of the tattoo world, Chris Núñez and Oliver Peck, a group of the country’s most creative and skilled tattoo artists compete for a hundred thousand dollars and the title of Ink Master. The stakes couldn’t be higher with “living canvasses” donating their skin to be permanently marked in this adrenalized competition elimination.

videos.title: Race to the Finish
videos.overview: The road to the finale begins with a 13-hour tattoo marathon; the artists must prove they have the endurance and skill to outlast their competitors and are worthy of the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Legends Return
videos.overview: 10 legends return to the Ink Master Shop and must immediately battle it out in an epic three round tattoo gauntlet for survival. The battle begins for $250,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: A Work of Art
videos.overview: Alliances start to form as the first Flash Challenge pushes the Artists' creativity to the limit. Then, a Fine Art Elimination Tattoo has the artists creating museum worthy pieces.

videos.title: Devil's in the Details
videos.overview: The Artists must make impressive illusions in an ultraviolet Flash Challenge, and every detail counts in an epic twist on Pin Up tattoos.

videos.title: Match a Master
videos.overview: In an unexpected twist, 4 Ink Masters show up to keep the Artists on their toes. The Master of Chaos stops by and flips the competition on its head.

videos.title: Master Mash Ups
videos.overview: A game-changing turn of events elevates the competition. Insane Mash Up tattoos puts the Artists artistry skills to the test and a skull pick backfires.

videos.title: Up in Flames
videos.overview: An explosive Flash Challenge has the original Artists targeting a common enemy. Difficult throat tattoos have the artists bugging out.

videos.title: Panes of Pressure
videos.overview: A layered Flash Challenge has the Artists testing their composure. The pressure is on as Japanese tattoos give the Artists a run for their money and a special Guest Judge stops by.

videos.title: Let the Sparks Fly
videos.overview: Sparks fly in a heavy metal Flash Challenge, and shots land in an intense skull pick. Things heat up in the race for the title when the Artists take on color portraits in the Elimination Tattoo.

videos.title: Finale Part 1
videos.overview: The final 6 Artists must take on 2 epic tattoo challenges to secure their place in the Top 4. Blind Judging shakes up the competition, and an emotional Elimination leaves the Artists feeling rattled.

videos.title: Finale Part 2
videos.overview: The top 4 Artists take on the most intense final tattoo in the history of the competition. Mind-blowing tattoos lead to a heated debate. One Artist wins $250,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: The New Ink Class
videos.overview: 15 brand new Artists enter the competition and must immediately fight for a shop. A game-changing twist shakes up the competition. The battle begins for $250,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Skull & Bones
videos.overview: An illuminating first Flash Challenge puts the new teams to the test. In the Elimination Tattoo, a seemingly straightforward Subject Matter forces some of the Artists out of their comfort zone. The battle heats up for the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Put Me In, Coach!
videos.overview: The Artists must rely on their Coaches in the Flash Challenge to design for a very special Human Canvas. There's nowhere to hide with 360 degree Elimination Tattoos testing adaptability.

videos.title: Don't Fork It Up
videos.overview: The artists must use their creativity to transform an ordinary object into an intricate sculpture in the Flash Challenge; the artists show their true colours with hybrid beast Elimination Tattoos.

videos.title: Teams Transformed
videos.overview: With only eight Artists left, an unexpected Team shuffle transforms the Competition. Transforming tattoos are judged blind as the battle continues for $250,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Saddle Up, Buttercup
videos.overview: Loyalties are tested when the new teams must work together in the Flash Challenge, and every detail counts with western-themed Elimination Tattoos. Yellowstone actor Jefferson White joins as a Guest Judge.

videos.title: Fight Fire with Fire
videos.overview: The Artists try not to lose their composure when they must paint with fire in the Flash Challenge, and a Science-themed Elimination Tattoo puts their skills under a microscope.

videos.title: Competition Shattered
videos.overview: The top five Artists try not to crack under the pressure in their final Flash Challenge and a twist on portrait day puts their drawing skills to the test.

videos.title: Instant Karma
videos.overview: The top four Artists call out their fellow competitors to earn their spot in the finale, but if they dish it out, they had better be able to take it, because Karma is one tricky lady.

videos.title: Fifteen's Finale
videos.overview: It all comes down to this! The top three Artists reveal their Master Canvas tattoos and a surprise jury of Ink Master winners raise the pressure. One Artist earns $250,000 and the title of Ink Master in the epic season finale.

videos.title: Divide of the Decade
videos.overview: 16 new Artists enter the competition, divided into two teams based on how long they've been tattooing. The Artists must fight for a spot on their team. The Young Guns are up first and the battle for $250,000 and the title of Ink Master begins.

videos.title: Money Where Your Mouth Is
videos.overview: With the Young Guns Team set, the OGs must now battle it out for a spot on their Team in another brutal double elimination. The battle for $250,000 and the title of Ink Master continues.

videos.title: Out of the Box, Onto the Skin
videos.overview: The battle for $250,000 intensifies as the Young Guns and OGs go head to head for the first time. The team dynamics are put to the test in the first Flash Challenge and basic lettering tattoos push the Artists' creativity to the limit.

videos.title: Inked in Gold
videos.overview: From trash to treasure, the teams must use their ingenuity to create recycled masterpieces in the Flash Challenge; metallic tattoos have the artists struggling to shine; a shocking elimination shakes up the competition.

videos.title: A Sin in Tattooing
videos.overview: Massive murals have the teams struggling to keep their composure in the Flash Challenge; the battle for the title of Ink Master continues with Japanese Samurai tattoos, and a backwards hand sparks a heated debate.

videos.title: At Your Service
videos.overview: Artists tattoo service dogs and face a twist battling for $250K and the title.

videos.title: Monsters Ink
videos.overview: Artists feel the pressure when a monstrous tattoo tests loyalties. The battle heats up.

videos.title: Face Your Fears
videos.overview: The Artists' loyalties become transparent in a glass painting Flash Challenge. There is nowhere to hide when the Artists must tattoo faces in a high stakes Elimination Tattoo. The battle for $250,000 continues.

videos.title: Mash Up Mayhem
videos.overview: In the epic fight to the finale, the final five Artists battle it out with mash up tattoos. A jaw-dropping twist puts their versatility to the test. Who will be the last three artists standing in the Ink Master Finale?

videos.title: OGs vs Young Gun
videos.overview: The 3 Finalists reveal their Master Canvas tattoos Familiar faces return in a final twist, and an unexpected surprise leaves the Artists in tears. One Artist will win $250,000 and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Hometown Throwdown
videos.overview: 15 global tattoo artists fight to represent their hometowns, but must first earn a spot to compete for $250k and the title of Ink Master.

videos.title: Back to the Drawing Board
videos.overview: The fight for a shop continues as artists tattoo hometown animals. For some, it's back to the drawing board. The battle is just beginning.

videos.title: Gut Check
videos.overview: In a team Flash Challenge, the Artists must paint with smoke. Glitter tattoos on the stomach have them struggling to shine, and an unexpected twist makes winning Tattoo of the Day more important than ever.

videos.title: Bottled Up
videos.overview: The Artists try to foil the competition in the Flash Challenge. Their artistry is put to the test with transparent bottle tattoos and one Artist becomes the Canvas in a bold move to survive. The battle for the title continues.

videos.title: It's A Marathon, Not A Sprint
videos.overview: The Artists face a brutal flash marathon, racing the clock to design and tattoo as many pieces as possible-on the body's toughest placements. With no room for error and a double elimination on the line, they must adapt to survive.

videos.title: No Day At The Beach
videos.overview: A sandy Flash Challenge pushes teams to the edge and a major meltdown shakes up the competition. Melting tattoos have everyone feeling the heat in the battle for $250,000.

videos.title: All Scars Will Heal
videos.overview: The Artists must transform scars into works of art in an emotional Elimination Tattoo. 3 Artists must prove their ingenuity in a Face Off for survival. The battle for $250,000 continues.

videos.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered
videos.overview: Things get sticky in the final Flash Challenge. Micro realistic postage stamp tattoos put the Artists' precision under a microscope. They'd better deliver - or their shot at the title could get lost in the mail.

videos.title: Tat For Tat
videos.overview: With a spot in the finale on the line, the remaining Artists take aim, designing tattoos meant to take each other down. A single misfire could turn triumph into tragedy and send someone packing right before the finish line.

videos.title: Hometown Hero
videos.overview: In the Season Finale, four Finalists reveal their Master Canvas tattoos. With an unexpected Guest Judge raising the stakes, only one Artist will take home $250,000 and the title of Ink Master.
